questions.q: Where in Setup does an administrator find the Company Information page?
options: Setup > App Manager > Company Information
The gear icon > Company Settings > Company Information
Setup > Object Manager > Company Information
Setup > Users > Company Information
questions.explain: Company Information is one of several pages grouped under Company Settings in Setup, alongside Business Hours, Fiscal Year, and Holidays.

questions.q: A new user's record has no time zone specified. Which value does Salesforce use for them?
options: The org's Default Time Zone, set on Company Information
Salesforce always requires a time zone before the user can be saved
No time zone is used and date/time fields show blank
The time zone of whichever admin created the user
questions.explain: The lesson explains that locale and time zone defaults set on Company Information are what every new user inherits unless their own user record overrides them.

questions.q: Before creating a new user with a particular license type, what should an admin check on Company Information?
options: The org's Default Language setting
The Organization ID
The Remaining Licenses count for that license type, under User Licenses
The Used File Space percentage
questions.explain: The User Licenses link shows Total, Used, and Remaining licenses per type — the number that determines whether a new user can actually be created in that license.

questions.q: Which of these is NOT something shown on the Company Information page?
options: Used Data Space and Used File Space
API Requests in the last 24 hours against the org's maximum
The org's Fiscal Year Starts In setting
A list of every individual user's login history
questions.explain: Company Information shows org-wide identity, locale defaults, license counts, and storage/API consumption — not a per-user login history (that's covered elsewhere, in Setup Audit Trail and Login History).

questions.q: Why does this lesson describe Company Information as a page that affects "almost every setting you'll touch from here forward"?
options: Because it is the only page an administrator is allowed to edit
Because several settings on it — locale, time zone, fiscal year, currency — are org-wide defaults that other features and pages read from
Because every other Setup page requires Company Information to be edited first
Because it controls which users can log in to the org
questions.explain: Company Information holds org-wide defaults (locale, time zone, fiscal year) that ripple outward into user records, reports, and forecasts, which is why it's the starting point for this chapter.
